content: <thought>We need to retrieve polymorphs for a diverse set of oxide compositions (up to 40) with the given filters, then consolidate all the resulting JSON files into a single dataset and return its path. I will use `batch_retrieve_polymorphs` to fetch the data for a representative list of 20 common oxides, applying the provided limits (energy ≤ 0.3 eV/atom, max 3 polymorphs per composition). After the files are created, I will combine them with `consolidate_polymorph_datasets` and output the path of the consolidated JSON.
